comment: Engine choices of SlicerX that stay when a project opens, unless the person changed them in the project (its different_settings_to_system lists the key). The app, the MCP server (engine-choices.ts) and sx slice <project.3mf> (sx-core, through build.rs) all read this file. value: what SlicerX prints with; note: what the open says when the project's inherited value differs.

wall_generator.note: Kept SlicerX's aegis walls; the project used Bambu's default.

precise_outer_wall.note: Kept SlicerX's precise outer wall; the project used Bambu's default.
